_comment: Volatile CNA-derived facts for the documentation snapshot. Every value was recomputed from the CNA TARGET commit (not copied from earlier audits). Presentations on the site are validated against this file by scripts/check_facts.py. External values are pinned to a revision.

renderer_identities.label: Public renderer identities
renderer_identities.method: cmake/RendererIdentities.cmake public list; cross-checked with the C++ enum, registry map, C ABI table and scripts/check_renderer_identities.py

implementation_families.label: Renderer implementation families
implementation_families.method: directories under modules/renderers that own a src/ (scripts/check_renderer_identities.py)

two_d_only_renderers.label: Deliberately 2D-only identities
two_d_only_renderers.method: ThreeD capability false in code: SDL_RENDERER, DIRECT2D, CANVAS, HTML_DOM, SVG_DOM, FREEDIRECT, GDI

compiled_effect_identities.label: Identities that can run compiled XNA effects (10 families)
compiled_effect_identities.method: FNA3D always on plus nine default-OFF *_COMPILED_EFFECTS options

platform_implementations.label: CNA_PLATFORM implementations
platform_implementations.method: cmake/PlatformSelection.cmake: SDL3 SDL2 X11 WAYLAND WIN32 HEADLESS TERMINAL

audio_implementations.label: CNA_AUDIO_PLATFORM implementations
audio_implementations.method: cmake/AudioPlatformSelection.cmake: SDL3 SDL2 NULL ALSA (SOUND_ENABLED for SDL3 and ALSA)

cpp_test_source_files.label: CNA-owned C++ test source files
cpp_test_source_files.method: rg --files -g '*.cpp' -g '!third_party/**' | awk '$0 ~ /(^|\/)(test|tests)(\/|$)/' | wc -l (same method reproduces BASE 568 exactly)

cpp_test_files_with_macros.label: Test files containing at least one counted macro

xna_runtime_types.label: XNA 4.0 runtime types represented
xna_runtime_types.method: tools/audit_xna_runtime_surface.py against Microsoft XML + DLL metadata (representation only)

xna_runtime_members.label: XNA 4.0 runtime members represented
xna_runtime_members.method: same census: 253 ctors + 1,518 methods + 1,040 properties + 753 fields + 63 events

xnb_builtin_readers.label: Built-in XNB readers (60 without native int128)

c_api_routes.label: Declared C routes
c_api_routes.method: declared name set equals the recorded export baseline

cna_samples.note: pinned external revision; not a CNA TARGET result

bindings_expected_abi.note: cna-cs, cna-java, cna-ts, cna-python, cna-rust, cna-swift, cna-go and cna-ruby (all public on GitHub since 2026-09-25) target ABI 0.21.x (cna-ruby also admits 0.7.0); TARGET exports 0.29.0
